name: Beijing Luzhu Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Luzhu Biotechnology Co., Ltd., a biotechnology company, develops human vaccines and therapeutic biologics to prevent and control infectious diseases, and to treat cancer and autoimmune diseases in Mainland China. The company is developing LZ901, a recombinant herpes zoster vaccine for which a biologics license application (BLA) has been submitted; K3, a recombinant human anti-tumor necrosis factor-alpha monoclonal antibody injection that has completed a Phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of autoimmune diseases, such as rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, and plaque psoriasis; and K193, a bispecific antibody injection in a Phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of B …
